title: Mostrar evidencia compacta de PIN, colisión y recuperación en Live móvil
mission: Repair the bounded Live v3 verification defect: preserve compact portfolio PIN/collision/recovery lineage in the published static feed and render meaningful task-detail evidence on mobile without cluttering the default view. Reuse existing durable portfolio evidence; do not add GitHub API exploration in the browser and do not alter Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
definition_of_done: build-live-feed publishes bounded lineage fields sufficient to identify current pin generation/owner plus collision/recovery evidence without exposing unnecessary raw payloads.
Live mobile task detail renders the lineage only on expansion; default worker list remains compact.
A contended fixture proves winner pin generation and at least one collision or recovery generation are legible.
Static feed remains the browser data source; no client-side GitHub API traversal is introduced.
6m/10m liveness behavior and existing swipe/inbox/history behavior do not regress.
No Current, Catalog, Human Accepted or Served pointer is changed.
